_provisional: PHASE 1 BOOTSTRAP ONLY. Not calibrated. Replaced by the Phase 4 grid sweep before any registered evaluation. Do not cite results produced with this artifact.
_note_portfolioResidualQuantileWad: PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDER, not calibrated (see _provisional above; replaced by the Phase 4 grid sweep). Derivation: forecast.ts's lowerBoundAt computes horizonMu = annualisedRateWad * horizonSeconds / SECONDS_PER_YEAR, then adds this quantile (<=0). At horizonSeconds=604800 (7d) the conversion factor is 604800/31536000 = 0.0191781, so a reference 5% APY venue (WAD-scale rate 5e16, mid-range for these lending markets) has a 7-day horizon return of 5e16 * 0.0191781 = 9.589e14. The PREVIOUS value here, -2e15, was LARGER IN MAGNITUDE than that entire reference return (and than an 8% APY venue's 1.534e15) so it drove every venue's lower bound negative and the optimiser deployed nothing, forever, with no error -- see task-11-report.md. This value, -1e13, is about 1% of the 5% reference horizon return: solving horizonMu + q = 0 for r gives a breakeven APY of only ~0.052%, so it stays out of the way of any realistically-yielding venue while remaining a strictly negative (conservative) shrink. It is NOT a calibrated dispersion estimate -- it exists only to let the pipeline admit and deploy capital in Phase 1; a later phase replaces it with a real quantile from completed-label residuals. AS OF 2026-09-08 this value is only a FALLBACK: when the artifact carries a `residualPanel` (which `evaluation/kernel/harness.ts#prepareArtifact` builds from the calibration split), `steps/portfolio-quantile.ts#portfolioResidualQuantileFor` computes q^p_alpha(w) from that panel under the candidate's own weights and this scalar is not used. It still governs when no panel can be calibrated -- including a window with no observed dispersion, where falling back to 0n would be the most optimistic value available rather than the most conservative.
_note_cashLowerBoundQuantileWad: PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDER, not calibrated (see _provisional above). Paper 7.2's SECOND registered target: a lower prediction bound on the venue's WITHDRAWABLE CASH over the horizon, which supplies e_i^cons in 8.1's reserve and phi_i in 8.2's objective. It is a RELATIVE quantile in WAD: steps/forecast.ts#withdrawableLowerBoundBase computes spotCash * (WAD + q) / WAD, so -1e17 means 'assume up to 10% of the venue's observed cash has drained by the time the vault needs to exit'. It is deliberately NOT 0: zero would make the predicted withdrawable cash equal the spot reading, i.e. exactly the pre-fix behaviour of audit NEW-11, reached silently through an absent calibration. 10% is a registered conservative default, not a measured figure -- evaluation/kernel/decision-input.ts#calibrateCashResidualQuantiles replaces it per venue whenever the calibration split has minObservations labels carrying an originCashBase, and this scalar governs only when it does not. Calibrating it properly needs the same multi-month collected MarketSnapshot series the return quantile and noTradeBandK need.
_note_paybackSeconds_adjustmentRate_edge: PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDERS, not calibrated (see _provisional above; this artifact is non-citable by construction). They are present so the artifact LOADS AND RUNS, not as a registration: steps/hurdles.ts#costHurdleWad throws on paybackSeconds <= 0, so without them any decide() that reaches a non-empty movement leg throws instead of holding -- which breaks scripts/phase1-fork-check.ts, whose buildPinnedArtifact replaces this artifact's empty pinnedConfigDigests with live on-chain digests and therefore DOES reach admission, and scripts/run-registered-evaluation.ts when invoked with no --artifact. The values reproduce scripts/freeze-artifact.ts exactly for this artifact's shape: PAYBACK_SECONDS = 30*24*60*60 = 2592000, ADJUSTMENT_RATE = 1, and effectiveWindow() = max(1, windowObservations / max(1, horizonSeconds/3600)) = max(1, 24/168) = 1 (this artifact's methodParams carry no windowObservations, so the freezer's own 24 default applies, and horizonSeconds is 604800). paybackSeconds is the window a move must repay its movement cost within (paper 9.1, P15) and adjustmentRate is 9.1.4's partial-adjustment rate lambda; BOTH are registered jointly with noTradeBandK by the turnover-vs-return sweep (P15, P18) this repository has not run, so a REGISTERED artifact must carry swept values and parseArtifact requires them there. Do NOT cite a result produced with these.
_note_noTradeBandK: NOT CALIBRATED. Paper 9.1 requires k to be "a registered scalar multiplier fixed before held-out evaluation"; 1.0 here carries no such registration and was never swept. Calibrating it needs a held-out turnover-vs-return sweep over a real collected dataset (the input this repo does not have yet: srcla has no multi-month MarketSnapshot series with the paper's registered horizons). Until that sweep runs, k=1.0 is a placeholder and any P8 result is provisional -- do NOT pick a value here because it makes a gate pass. The band's OTHER input, sigma_hat, is no longer a placeholder: steps/portfolio-quantile.ts derives it from the calibration split's residual panel under the target's own weights.
